description: Shared source-capture consent parity fixture. The Rust daemon (crates/daemon/src/config.rs), the OpenCode plugin loader (packages/opencode-plugin/src/config/index.ts), and the Pi plugin loader (packages/pi-plugin/src/config/index.ts) load every row through their production loaders and must produce the same effective source_capture.enabled value. The same loaders read every row again with the source_capture block renamed to verifier, a user-only switch with the same default and tier rule, and must produce the same effective verifier.enabled value and the same warning count for verifier.
contract: A row's user tier is written as eidnara.jsonc under the user config directory and its project tier as <project>/.eidnara/eidnara.jsonc; an empty object writes an empty document.
expected_enabled is the effective source_capture.enabled. The key is user-only and defaults to false, so the project tier never changes it in either direction.
A user-tier value that is not a boolean leaves the default, so capture stays off.

expected_project_warning is true when the project tier sets source_capture.enabled; every loader then reports, exactly once, that it ignored source_capture from the project tier. A project block that leaves the switch unset changes nothing and draws no warning.
Every row also holds for verifier after the source_capture block is renamed to verifier: the same expected_enabled, and expected_project_warning then counts the warning that names verifier.

rows.name: the user tier disables it explicitly
the project tier cannot enable it
the project tier cannot override a user disable
the project tier cannot disable a user enable
a project block without the switch
